# Description
Using genome shuffling to test for enrichment of LRR in GRBs

# Libraries
```{r Libraries, message=FALSE}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(tidyverse)
library("vsn")
library(kohonen)


project_dir <- "/home/katarina/MyProjects/targPred"
inputs_dir <- "data/inputs"
processed_dir <- "data/processed"
outputs_dir <- "/data/outputs"

source(file.path(project_dir, "src/scripts/utils.R"))
```

Loading data
Loading only chromosome 18 data since it has the least interactions
```{r}
chr <- "chr18"
empP_gr_18 <- read.table(file = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "empP_et_all_files_denovo", paste0("empP_CAGEen_denovo_hg19Ens_6.4Mb_", chr, ".txt")),
    header = TRUE)

fantom5.enhancers.tpm.gr <- readRDS(file.path(project_dir, processed_dir,"fantom5.enhancers.tpm.pooled.gr.rds"))

promoter_cage_tpm_df <- readRDS(file.path(project_dir, processed_dir,"promoter_cage_tpm_df_fixed_pooled.rds"))

temp <- read.table(file = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "empP_et_all_files_denovo", paste0("pearson_CAGEen_denovo_hg19Ens_6.4Mb_", chr, ".txt")),
    header = TRUE)

empP_gr_18$pearson_r <- temp$pearson_r
empP_gr_18$pearson_p <- temp$pearson_p

p_thresh <- 0.001
```

Number of significant pairs
```{r}
table(empP_gr_18$empP < 0.001)
table(empP_gr_18$spearman_p < 0.001)
table(empP_gr_18$pearson_p < 0.001)

prop.table(table(empP_gr_18$empP < 0.001, empP_gr_18$spearman_p < 0.001))
prop.table(table(empP_gr_18$empP < 0.001, empP_gr_18$pearson_p < 0.001))
prop.table(table(empP_gr_18$spearman_p < 0.001, empP_gr_18$pearson_p < 0.001))

table(empP_gr_18$empP < 0.001, empP_gr_18$spearman_p < 0.001)
table(empP_gr_18$empP < 0.001, empP_gr_18$pearson_p < 0.001)
table(empP_gr_18$spearman_p < 0.001, empP_gr_18$pearson_p < 0.001)

```

```{r}
data_ <- empP_gr_18 %>%
    filter(spearman_p < p_thresh & pearson_p < p_thresh) %>%
    mutate(empP_signf = ifelse(empP < p_thresh, TRUE, FALSE))

ggplot(data_, aes(x = pearson_r, y = spearman_r, color = empP_signf)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(n = 8, name = "RdBu")[c(2,7)], name ="empP significance") + 
    ylim(0.2, 0.75) + 
    xlim (0.2, 0.9) +
    geom_density_2d(alpha = 1) +
    theme_bw()+
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20)) +
    labs(x = "Pearson's r", y = "Spearman's rho")
ggsave(height = 10, width = 10, file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "statistics_seminar/spearman_pearson_scatterplot.png"))


```
Reviewing p value distributions
```{r}
hist(empP_gr_18$empP)
hist(empP_gr_18$spearman_p)

```

```{r}
meanSdPlot(promoter_cage_tpm_df, ranks = FALSE) +
    ylim(0,40000)

promoter_cage_mean_sd <- as.data.frame(promoter_cage_tpm_df) %>%
    mutate(mean_value = rowMeans(.),   # Calculate mean for each row
    sd_value = apply(., 1, sd)) %>%
    select(mean_value, sd_value)

# filtering some outliers
data_ <- promoter_cage_mean_sd %>%
    filter(sd_value < 1000)

ggplot(data_, aes(x = mean_value, y = sd_value)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 50) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20))+
    labs(x = "Mean value", y = "Standard deviation")
ggsave(height = 10, width = 10, file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "statistics_seminar/meanSdPlot.png"))
```


```{r}
# Largest combined score
enh_1 <- c("chr18:76831132-76831674", "ENSG00000166377:ENST00000307671")
# target gene and low spearman big eff size
enh_2 <- c("chr18:19759263-19759580", "ENSG00000141448:ENST00000269216")
# High spearman
enh_3 <- c("chr18:13382338-13382799", "ENSG00000168675:ENST00000586222")
# Second highest
enh_4 <- c("chr18:73628376-73628483", "ENSG00000150656:ENST00000358821")
# Outliers in ro r plot and one star(*) empP
enh_5 <- c("chr18:46467138-46467469", "ENSG00000101665:ENST00000262158")
# Also outlier empp =1
enh_6 <- c("chr18:47834061-47834491", "ENSG00000134042:ENST00000256425")
# High pearson and spearman
enh_7 <- c("chr18:13382338-13382799", "ENSG00000168675:ENST00000586222")
# High Spearman low Pearson
enh_8 <- c("chr18:13217020-13217525","ENSG00000168675:ENST00000399848")
# not empP significant and 
enh_9 <- c("chr18:21417655-21417852","ENSG00000053747:ENST00000269217")
# empP significant, no pearson and spearman
enh_10 <- c("chr18:45581027-45581432", "ENSG00000154832:ENST00000285106")
enh_11 <- c("chr18:6416928-6417109","ENSG00000101608:ENST00000217652")


my_enh <- enh_10

s <- subsetByOverlaps(fantom5.enhancers.tpm.gr, GRanges(my_enh[1]))
enh_expression <- apply(as.data.frame(mcols(s)), 2, sum)
p <- promoter_cage_tpm_df[rownames(promoter_cage_tpm_df) == my_enh[2]]
expression_for_pair <- data.frame(enh_expression=enh_expression, prom=p)

col2plot <- brewer.pal(8, "PiYG")[8]

plot_beanplot_individual_modified(expression_for_pair, neuronal = FALSE, 
                                  col2plot = col2plot, sign="permutation", n = 1,
                                  fn = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "statistics_seminar", paste0("beanplots", my_enh[2],"-", start(my_enh[1]), ".png")))

pearson_cor <- cor.test(x =expression_for_pair$enh_expression,
    y = expression_for_pair$prom,
    method = "pearson")

spearman_cor <- cor.test(x =expression_for_pair$enh_expression,
    y = expression_for_pair$prom,
    method = "spearman")

ggplot(expression_for_pair, aes(x = enh_expression, y = prom)) +
    geom_point()+
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    geom_text(x = min(expression_for_pair$enh_expression)+ 0.4, y = max(expression_for_pair$prom)-4, label = paste0("Pearson corelation: ", round(pearson_cor$estimate, 3)), size = 10) +
    geom_text(x = min(expression_for_pair$enh_expression)+ 0.4, y = max(expression_for_pair$prom)-2, label = paste0("Spearman corelation: ", round(spearman_cor$estimate, 2)), size = 10)+
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20)) +
    labs(x = "Enhancer expression", y = "Promoter expression")

ggsave(file =  file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "statistics_seminar", paste0("correlation:", my_enh[2],"-", my_enh[1], ".png")))


```


Relation of number of pairs and distance tested
```{r}
ggplot(empP_gr_18, aes(x = log10(EP_dist), fill = "ALL")) +
    geom_histogram(bins=150, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_histogram(data = filter(empP_gr_18, empP < p_thresh), aes(x =log10(EP_dist), fill ="Signif"), bins = 150, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_histogram(data = filter(empP_gr_18, empP > p_thresh), aes(x =log10(EP_dist), fill ="Not-Signif"), bins = 150, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkblue", "black", "darkred")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20))

ggsave(height = 10, width = 20, file =  file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "statistics_seminar", paste0("distribution_of_EP_dist.png"))) 
```

# WIlcox on enhancer pairs
```{r}
E_active <- expression_for_pair$enh_expression > 0


wilcox.test(x = expression_for_pair$prom[E_active], y = expression_for_pair$prom[!E_active])

```

# SOMs
```{r}
data_ <- matrix(c(expression_for_pair$enh_expression, expression_for_pair$prom), ncol = 2)

# Create a SOM grid
som_grid <- somgrid(xdim = 5, ydim = 5, topo = "hexagonal")

# Train the SOM
som_model <- som(data_, grid = som_grid)

plot(som_model)
plot(som_model, type="counts")
plot(som_model, type="mapping")
```


```{r}

# Set the parameters for the density distribution
mean_value <- 70 
sd_value <- 15

# Generate random data
set.seed(123)
data <- data.frame(
  Value = rnorm(1000, mean = mean_value, sd = sd_value)
)

# Create plot using ggplot
ggplot(data, aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_density(fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.5) +
#   stat_function(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = mean_value, sd = sd_value),
#                 aes(color = "True"), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = "black", labels = "True") +
  labs(title = "Density Distribution",
       x = "Promoter TMPs", y = "Density") +
  theme_bw() +
  xlim(0, 100)

ggsave(height = 10, width = 20, file =  file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "statistics_seminar", paste0("distribution_active.png"))) 


```
